purpose: Verify whether natural constant-channel cases can acquire additional usable station observations
retrieval: EarthScope FDSN 150-second waveform plus StationXML, one hand-selected indexed additional station per case initially
selection_limit: Diagnostic feasibility pilot; station choices are unblinded and not a performance sample
acceptance: complete requested time coverage within one sample
matching station epoch and channel orientation
next_model_experiment: AGH-mediated paired fixed-full evidence vs adaptive retrieval only after input semantics and independent acceptance are frozen
